nodes.label: LOOM Language
nodes.description: A live-coding music language with an AI brain that runs in browser, phone, and terminal. Designed for musicians/composers learning to code.

nodes.label: loom-core (Rust)
nodes.description: Zero-dependency Rust crate containing the parser, verbs, and per-bar scheduler. Fully tested and serves as the single source of truth for the language logic.

nodes.label: loom-wasm (WASM)
nodes.description: wasm-bindgen wrapper around loom-core for browser and phone execution.

nodes.label: loom-tui (Terminal)
nodes.description: Terminal client skeleton using native audio and terminal grid UI (ratatui).

nodes.label: Web Prototype (JavaScript)
nodes.description: Browser-based LOOM with JavaScript engine (web/index.html). Playground for testing language features before porting to Rust.
